Free Generation Maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate AI-powered videos from short text prompts, delivered as 1080p MP4 files.
- Supports uploads in MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF, and more (up to 500MB).
- Automatic backend connection and anonymous authentication with 100 free credits.
- Simple chat interface—drop prompts or files, request status, export, or check credits.
- Key workflows: quick video creation, batch processing, iterative editing with session state.
- Detailed error handling and request attribution for smooth operation.
